authority: R-167 v1.1 exact finite-volume analytic extension and route split. The exact Schrodinger cross identity and Heinz--Kato graph interpolation close the formerly open centered-weight cubic multiplier in its optimal weighted form. A heat-simplex lemma is exact for each prescribed bond word, while factorial connected-history multiplicity and an exp(C/epsilon) strip boundary reject two raw absolute-value real-time proof routes. A first-passage product response estimate is isolated as the remaining phase-independent route. A separate equilibrium cutoff balance identifies a local fifth onsite-energy moment plus genuinely two-sided modular/dual-state control as a possible fixed-beta phase-pair W-star route; neither ingredient is yet proved for Q3LOCK.

moving_site_boundary.finding: For a normalized compact product bump translated by amplitude R at a site x, ||q_x,e^3 psi_R||>=(R-1)^3 while ||A psi_R||<=C0+C1 f_x R^4. Hence every unweighted moving-site graph constant is at least proportional to f_x^-3/4.
moving_site_boundary.consequence: The centered weighted estimate is optimal in spatial order; a locality proof must absorb exp(3mu d(x,X)/4) or recenter the energy graph at each first-passage step.
moving_site_boundary.does_not_show: It does not refute boundedness at any fixed x, a recentered product estimate, or exact thermodynamic dynamics.

moving_center_comparison.neighbor_bound: For neighboring centers x,y, ||A_x A_y^-1|| and ||A_y A_x^-1|| are at most C_mu=1+2(exp(mu)-1)(1+kappa).
moving_center_comparison.proof: The potential difference is at most theta U_y and the commuting kinetic-weight difference is at most theta T_y, while ||U_y A_y^-1||<=kappa and ||T_y A_y^-1||<=2+kappa.
moving_center_comparison.consequence: A fixed graph exponent pays only C_mu^(s n) along an n-step recentered backbone; branch/repeat resummation remains open.

absolute_route_obstructions.raw_animal: A length-m backbone with four transverse leaves at each of m selected vertices has n=5m edges and at least (4m)! legal connected growth histories. The raw absolute majorant (4m)! a^(5m)/Gamma(1+5m/2) has log=(3/2)m log m+O(m), so it has zero radius for every a>0.
absolute_route_obstructions.strip_boundary: After an assumed chain reduction with P=2z-1, the absolute complex-time bound contains exp[P^2 kappa0^2 exp(2rho)|epsilon+it/hbar|^2/epsilon]. Its Balakrishnan integral contains integral_0^1 epsilon^(s-1) exp(C/epsilon)d epsilon and diverges for every finite s at t!=0.
absolute_route_obstructions.scope: These are hard falsifiers for the named termwise-absolute animal and strip-continuation methods, not nonexistence results for the real-time dynamics.

conditional_real_time_product.response_target: After summing every branch and repeated-edge history sharing one first-passage backbone pi, prove in both one-sided orientations integral_Delta_n(t)||R_(pi,n)^(j) A^-s_j|| <= C_j[G_j sqrt(|t|/hbar)]^n/Gamma(1+n/2), with s_1=1/2 and s_2=3/4.
conditional_real_time_product.downstream: For rho>mu/4 this supplies the R-167 conditional two-sided volume-Cauchy theorem. The proved moving-center comparison adds only C_mu^(s_j n), which can be absorbed into G_j. A Hamiltonian-derived invariant C-star algebra or uniform two-sided energy-tail compactness is still required.

equilibrium_cutoff_alternative.moment_target: sup_(Lambda,h,x) phi_(Lambda,h)(k_(x,h)^p)<=M_p for one p>d+1; p=5 is sufficient in d=3
equilibrium_cutoff_alternative.scale_balance: With R_m=m^b and 2d/(p-1)<b<2, the candidate leakage exponent d+b(1-p)/2 is negative and the projected factorial tail is superexponentially small.
equilibrium_cutoff_alternative.topology_requirement: The moment and exponent balance alone do not prove nontracial strong-star convergence. One must additionally prove both one-sided/dual-state cutoff control or a uniform modular-energy tail on a predeclared faithful mixture or separating state class.
equilibrium_cutoff_alternative.possible_scope: At most a fixed-beta, predeclared phase-pair common normal W-star dynamics before a separate beta/state-independent C-star algebra theorem.

duhamel_topology_counterexample.fixture: H e_n=n e_n, p_n=(1-exp(-beta))exp(-beta n), X_n=|e_n><e_0|
duhamel_topology_counterexample.duhamel: The squared Duhamel norms satisfy (X_n,X_n)_D=(X_n*,X_n*)_D=(p_0-p_n)/(beta n)->0
duhamel_topology_counterexample.strong_boundary: X_n e_0=e_n and the symmetric GNS square norm tends to p_0/2, so strong-star convergence fails
duhamel_topology_counterexample.repair: A uniform modular bandwidth Omega gives ||X||_(rho,#)^2<=[beta Omega/2 coth(beta Omega/2)](X,X)_D; otherwise a high-modular-energy tail theorem is required.
duhamel_topology_counterexample.scope: Duhamel-inner-product convergence alone is rejected; KMS or state-weighted dynamics itself is not rejected.
